content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemical ingredients and polymers for formulators; not mining or processing potash, salt or fertilizer."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Roofing membranes, insulation and industrial components for construction; no mining or fertilizer business."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Mines and processes salt for deicing and industrial use and sells sulfate of potash fertilizer to agriculture, matching the target's lines."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Construction products, HVAC and industrial components; no mining, fertilizer or deicing business."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Makes nitrogen fertilizer from natural gas, not mined potash; shares farm customers but a different product and process."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemicals, fibers and materials sold to manufacturers; no mining or agricultural mineral business."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Thermal coal mining and coal-fired power generation for utilities; different product and customers."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Corn-based fuel ethanol and feed co-products; agricultural inputs but a different process and end market."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Makes nitrogen chemicals and heat pumps; shares some fertilizer and mining customers but not potash or salt mining."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Mines clay sorbents sold mainly as cat litter to retail consumers; shares mining but not fertilizer or deicing products."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Chlor-alkali chemicals, epoxy and ammunition manufacturing; no mining of fertilizer minerals or deicing salt."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Ethylene production from purchased feedstock sold under long-term contracts to petrochemical buyers; different business."}]}
